name: city
description: Dense urban core (Zurich) at a high zoom: exercises buildings (fill-extrusion), dense road network (line), and land-use fills.

name: region
description: Country/region-level overview (Central Europe) at a low zoom: exercises country/state fills, coastlines, and sparse major roads.

name: rural
description: Low-density rural area (Swiss countryside) at a middling zoom: exercises terrain-ish land-cover fills, forest, and minor roads with few buildings.

name: coast
description: Open-water strait with a maritime admin boundary (the Oresund, between Denmark and Sweden) at a mid zoom: exercises the `boundary` layer's `maritime`/`disputed` filters (must exclude maritime-tagged lines) and coastline fills, at a zoom close enough to make stray boundary lines over open water obvious.
